channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Two mechanics have closed their Salt Lake City shop after decades. Their customers have stories to tell.
item.description: After decades of servicing cars and earning customers' trust in Salt Lake City, Brigham Street Service is closed. Its loyal customers have some stories to tell.

item.title: ‘It’s spectacular’: Why winter may just be the best time to visit Zion National Park.
item.description: A winter visit to Zion offers unique opportunities to see the park with less crowds and heat but also brings its own safety concerns. Here's what local guides and park staff recommend for a successful trip.

item.title: ‘I will have to start from scratch’ — a Latter-day Saint convert prepares to self-deport
item.description: A Salvadoran Latter-day Saint and her children entered the country legally. Under the Trump administration, that hasn’t been enough to keep them together.

item.title: 4 years after Olympic scandal, athletes sue U.S. Ski & Snowboard, former coach over alleged sexual abuse
item.description: Three former Team USA snowboarders filed a lawsuit in Utah court against former Olympics coach Peter Foley and U.S. Ski & Snowboard almost exactly four years after allegations of sexual abuse by Foley became public during the 2022 Beijing Winter Games.

item.title: Prop 4 repeal organizers fire paid gatherers after Utah County clerk alleges fraudulent signatures
item.description: The Utah County Clerk has turned over several petition packets to the county attorney for an investigation into whether they were forged. A total of 27 packets containing hundreds of signatures have been flagged as potentially having falsified signatures.

item.title: Utah tech grew up on Silicon Valley’s playbook. Silicon Slopes wants to move on.
item.description: After a decade of bolstering Utah tech businesses, Silicon Slopes is asking what entrepreneurship should look like. At the Summit, leaders urged moving beyond Silicon Valley’s playbook, embracing AI and building sustainable companies — not just unicorns.

item.title: Letter: Wearing masks encourages transgressive behavior. The effect is dehumanizing.
item.description: Letter: By either allowing or requiring ICE agents to wear a mask, the government is encouraging behavior that an individual or group might never do if they were not wearing a mask.

item.title: Letter: The Legislature’s message to the Utah Supreme court is clear
item.description: Letter: The Legislature’s message to the Utah Supreme court is clear — we do whatever we want, and you rule in our favor, or else.

item.title: Letter: Revamping our abhorrent immigration system would surely be cheaper than what ICE is costing us
item.description: Letter: Undocumented people who have lived here for years, raised families and paid taxes, made themselves valuable members of their communities, are living in fear.

item.title: Letter: We must do more than just say the words ‘civil dialogue’
item.description: Letter: We must learn the skills and foundation of treating others with dignity, or our society and democracy will suffer. A house divided against itself will fall.
